scope: Apply the accepted Tai geometry interpreter on first processing of actual body responses; no response repair or repeat inference.
permitted_omission: Only absent root uncertainty with status=ok, accepted root keys and otherwise valid table/fragment/label/member geometry structure.

missing_metadata.disposition: NOT PROVIDED; never model-reported empty uncertainty

compatibility_view: A private deep copy supplies uncertainty=[] only to invoke the unchanged frozen decoder. Raw model selection is retained exactly; derived mapped uncertainty is restored to null. No member or geometry is changed.
diagnostics: Retain the original strict table diagnostic and the frozen figure-geometry diagnostic separately, including metadata-presence warnings.
refusals: Invalid PRESENT uncertainty, unknown IDs or keys, missing geometry, ambiguous membership, nonfinite/inverted bounds and nonpositive fragment unions remain failures. Empty/unresolved statuses use the unchanged frozen handling.
existing_warnings: Finite degenerate source members and within-fragment duplicates retain all extrema and raw occurrences under the accepted table policy.
human_acceptance: Pending review of this experiment; the Tai acceptance does not accept new outputs.
